desc: The CZ 457 Target features a fully adjustable, ISSF competition-ready aluminum chassis co-developed with Olympic winner Matt Emmons, ensuring outstanding ergonomics for shooters of all sizes, ages, and skill levels. The following elements can be adjusted in pretty much any way possible. You can make your CZ 457 Target grip fit pretty much any palm out there. The three-axis-adjustable pistol grip available in three different sizes ensures maximum comfort and a firm grasp. The CZ 457 Target stock offers a three-axis-adjustable, two-sided cheekpiece with a different shape on each side for optimal cheek weld. It is paired with an even more flexible side-tiltable buttstock with a five-axis-adjustable buttpad. All of this is topped with a three-segment shoulder hook adjustable for shape and tilt. The CZ 457 Target forehand riser can be adjusted in three different axes to comfortably position the rifle in your supporting hand.
